title: The etale sheaf associated with a quasi-coherent module
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent
$\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The associated sheaf $\mathcal F_{\mathrm{et}}$
on the small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] assigns to
$u:U\to X$ the group $\Gamma(U,u^*\mathcal F)$, with the usual
pullback restrictions. Here $u^*\mathcal F$ is pullback as a module
on a ringed space [def-pc-module-pullback]. Explicitly, for an $X$-morphism $g:U'\to U$ between objects $u:U\to X$, $u'=u\circ g:U'\to X$ of $X_{\Et}$, the restriction is
$$\rho_g:\Gamma(U,u^*\mathcal F)\to\Gamma(U',u'^*\mathcal F),\qquad s\mapsto c_{g,u}(g^*s),$$
where $g^*s\in\Gamma(U',g^*u^*\mathcal F)$ is the image of $s$ under the unit $u^*\mathcal F\to g_*g^*u^*\mathcal F$ of the adjunction $g^*\dashv g_*$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] and $c_{g,u}:g^*u^*\mathcal F\xrightarrow{\sim}(u\circ g)^*\mathcal F$ is the composition isomorphism [lem-pc-module-pullback-identity-composition]; that these maps are additive and make $u\mapsto\Gamma(U,u^*\mathcal F)$ a presheaf of abelian groups on $X_{\Et}$ is [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial]. That this presheaf is already a sheaf of abelian groups on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] – so that
the assignment defines a sheaf and not merely a presheaf – is the
descent property of quasi-coherent modules,
[lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-descent], and it is not part of the
definition.
